'''CTBC Flying Oyster''' (Also known as 中信飛牡蠣) is a [[:category:Taiwan|Taiwanese]] esports organisation owned by Taiwanese company '''CTBC''', which also own baseball team '''CTBC Brothers''' and basketball team '''New Taipei CTBC DEA'''.

==History==
===Entry into LoL and Worlds debut (2022)===
CTBC Flying Oyster entered League of Legends esports and the [[PCS]] after acquiring [[Hong Kong Attitude]]'s slot, replacing the team that had competed in League of Legends since 2013. In their debut season, finished in joined 3rd place with [[Deep Cross Gaming]] in the regular season, securing them a spot in the Upper Bracket for the playoffs. They would continue their route through the upper bracket all the way through the finals, where a narrow 2-3 rematch loss against [[PSG Talon]] kept them out of the [[Mid-Season_Invitational/2022|2022 Mid-Season Invitational]]. 

The team made few changes to their roster for the following [[PCS/2022/Summer|Summer Season]]. They finished the regular season in fourth place but a much more successful playoffs run against [[Frank Esports]], [[PSG Talon]] and [[Beyond Gaming]] won them the championship and a spot at the [[World_Championship/2022|2022 World Championship]] group stage. A massive underdog in their group, Flying Oysters got just one win (against [[100 Thieves]]) and finished in joined last place with the LCS representatives.

===Search for second gold and Worlds return (2023)===
Ahead of the [[PCS/2023/Spring|2023 Spring]] season, the team parted ways with Sung  "[[Atlen]]" Ya-lun, Chen "[[M1ssion]]" Hsiao-hsien and Lin "[[Koala_(Taiwanese_player)|Koala]]" Chih-chiang. Koala however would end up returning to the organization a month later as a part of the coaching staff. CTBC also notably picked up Tseng "[[JimieN]]" Hao-chun, who had just come of a year in North America where he was a part of [[100 Thieves Academy]]. Former [[Hong Kong Attitude]] player Lin "[[S1aytrue]]" Sheng-po also joined the team

Despite these changes — and also picking up veteran Liu "[[ShiauC]]" Chia-hao in Summer — CTBC Oyster failed to secure a second domestic gold medal, finishing third in Spring and second in Summer, but booked a ticket to the [[World_Championship/2023|2023 World Championship]] play-in stage nonetheless. Finishing behind [[Team Whales]] and [[Team BDS]] in groups, however, made for a short Worlds run and sent CTBC home to prepare for 2024.

==Trivia==
* The name '''Flying Oyster'''' comes from the teams sponsor, CTBC, which has the slogan "We are family.". In mandarin, Flying Oyster (飛牡蠣) is pronounced as ''"fay-moo-lee"'', which reflects the sponsors slogan. Also maing the teams name in chinese read as ''' CTBC Family'''. <ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/xyfrv0/flying_oyster_name_origin/ |title="Flying Oyster" name origin|author=Noobiate |language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>
